english_translation:
Worship the Lord with heart melted in love;
Seek the Lord, with love
When we direct our love to God
He too approaches us with love.
notes: Adore the Lord melting in love; He is the source of all Love. To me He showed His infinite love.

english_translation:
The Lord who sports on His Head honeyed with Kontrai flowers,
Who was self-born before the beginning of time
And who abides even after the pralaya
He came to me out of His great compassion.

Many know not Him who first wrought this world,
And wrapt in infinite Love, born of His lordly Grace;
In this world, evil-ridden, He filled our life
With His love unending, He, the Lord of limitless space.
notes: Out of infinite love for us He created this world, that by that love we may know bliss true. Of limitless dimensions He is; and yet He contains Himself in the love of our tiny heart.

english_translation:
The Light Refulgent emits beams of purest gold;
Plant that deep and firm in heart; raising worship thus,
If you, in yearning song, seek Isan's Grace,
Then, sure, no end be to His blessings copious.

english_title: Seek in Love the Heavenly Father
english_translation:
Birth He caused, and Death, too, in its wake;
This mystery we daily see; and yet mankind
Cling in deep desire to life, but call not on Him,
Nor seek Him, saying, "Our Father, great and kind."

notes: Siva rewards us as our love for Him merits. In His love He gave us this world. Will He not in His love also extricate us from birth's cycle, if we seek Him?

english_translation:
The Lord gave us this life to attain supreme bliss,
But we spent it in deeds that bring misery
Yet if we have love for Him
He will put an end to our rebirths.

If we have love there will be spiritual glory, and
The grace of the Mother will come to us,
So give up attachment to the body-mind complex,
And seek the Lord ardently.

Like the sweet love in sex-act experienced,
So, in the Great Love, let yourself to Him succumb;
Thus in Love sublimed, all your senses stilled,
Bounding in Bliss Supreme, That this becomes

Even the Siddhas, standing close in banded group,
Knew not the Light Supreme in splendorous glow;
But He gave Salvation's bliss and the Vision splendid,
To them whose hearts did in intense devotion overflow.
notes: Even enlightened Siddhas have not visioned the Divine Light; but in intense love He is envisioned.

english_translation:
I saw the Feet of the Lord, deckt in odorous Konrai blooms,
I saw the Feet of the Lord, dark-dressed in elephant-skin,
I saw the Feet of the Lord, on lotus-blossom abiding
I saw the Feet of the Lord, my heart-core's love within.
notes: I visioned Him in the intense love of heart's core. In that love I visioned Him decked in konrai blossoms, dressed in dark-elephant skin, and abiding on a lotus blossom.

english_translation:
My Lord God whom the heavenly beings praise
As one into myriad forms and things outspread,
The Great Lover who inside love savours love's tributes;
Sad indeed that few seek Him, or to Him are led.
notes: The celestial beings seek Him in diverse forms; but He savours in love's tributes.

english_translation:
Those who know nothing but the cycle of birth and death
Think that through worldly love they can attain the Lord,
But the Lord is beyond birth and death,
Only through true devotion can He be attained.

The Lord God knows them who, by night and day,
Seat Him in heart's core, and in love exalted adore;
To them wise with inner light, actionless in trance,
He comes, and, in close proximity, stands before.
notes: He knows them who night and day seat Him in the heart's core in exalted love. He stands before them as inner light as they love him in actionless trance.
